About Compass

Compass is a new venture incubated within MISUMI Americas. We’re building it with the deep manufacturing expertise of Fictiv, MISUMI’s digital manufacturing platform.

Every physical product starts as a CAD model, and most of what it will cost is decided right there. Yet cost and manufacturability are still checked after the drawings are released, by hand and in spreadsheets, when every change is slow and expensive. The result is redesigns, missed schedules, and money left on the factory floor. Compass fixes that at the source. An engineer uploads an assembly, and Compass reads every part the way an expert manufacturing engineer would. It checks each feature against the processes that could make it, prices the part at the volume that matters, reads tolerances and GD&T straight off the drawing, and ranks exactly what to change. It does this across the entire bill of materials, reruns on every revision, and learns from every correction engineers make.
